record_type_quote: This paper presented two conceptual replication studies attempting to evaluate the link between BJW and deception detection accuracy, which was observed in prior work (Schindler & Reinhard, 2015). In both studies, the original result failed to replicate as personal and global BJW subscales were not statistically related to deception detection abilities.
